content.json:
# Azure VM Inventory - SKU Restrictions

Inventory of virtual machines highlighting SKUs, VM generation, disk controller type, and encryption status.

Select one or more subscriptions above. Unsuffixed VM sizes are classified as **v1**; explicit `_v2`, `_v3`, and `_v4` suffixes are classified accordingly. **ADE (AzureDiskEncryption)** is distinct from platform-managed server-side encryption, as is **Encryption at Host**.

content.query:
resources
| where type == 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| extend vmSize = properties["hardwareProfile"]["vmSize"]
| extend normalizedVMSize = tolower(vmSize)
| extend imagePublisher = tostring(properties.storageProfile.imageReference.publisher)
| extend imageOffer = tostring(properties.storageProfile.imageReference.offer)
| extend imageSku = tostring(properties.storageProfile.imageReference.sku)
| extend SKUVersion = case(normalizedVMSize endswith '_v2', 'v2', normalizedVMSize endswith '_v3', 'v3', normalizedVMSize endswith '_v4', 'v4', normalizedVMSize matches regex '_v[0-9]+$', 'Outside v1-v4', 'v1')
| extend vmGen = properties["extended"]["instanceView"]["hyperVGeneration"]
| extend diskController = properties["storageProfile"]["diskControllerType"]
| extend encryptAtHost = properties["securityProfile"]["encryptionAtHost"]
| extend vmID = tolower(id)
| project vmName = name,
          vmID,
          vmSize,
          SKUVersion,
          vmGen,
          imagePublisher,
          imageOffer,
          imageSku,
          diskController,
          encryptAtHost,
          location
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/extensions'
    | extend vmId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/extensions/')[0]))
    | extend extPublisher = tostring(properties.publisher)
    | extend extType = tostring(properties.type)
    | extend ade = case(extType startswith "AzureDiskEncryption", 'true', '')
    | where extType == 'AzureDiskEncryption' or extType == 'AzureDiskEncryptionForLinux'
    | project AzureDiskEncryption = ade,
              vmId
) on $left.vmID == $right.vmId
| project-away vmID, vmId
| project vmName,
          vmSize,
          SKUVersion,
          vmGen,
          diskController,
          AzureDiskEncryption,
          encryptAtHost,
          imageOffer,
          imageSku,
          imagePublisher,
          location
content.title: Virtual machine details

content.json:
## Data interpretation

- **VM SKU Version** uses the version designation from the VM size.
- **VM Generation** uses the VM instance view.
- **Disk Controller** uses the diskControllerType from the storage profile.
- **ADE = true** when Resource Graph finds the `AzureDiskEncryption` / `AzureDiskEncryptionForLinux` VM extension. This does not classify server-side encryption or encryption at host as ADE.
- **Encryption At Host - true** when Resource Graph finds the encryptionAtHost flag set in the VM securityProfile. This does not classify server-side encryption or Azure Disk Encryption as Encryption At Host
- **Image Offer/SKU/Publisher** uses instance-view data when available, then the configured Marketplace image reference. Specialized or older VMs may report `Unknown`.
- Resource Graph access and freshness determine which resources and properties appear.
